title: Cohen-Macaulayness of formal fibers and dimension of local cohomology modules
summary: Let $(R, \mathfrak{m} )$ be a Noetherian local ring, $M$ a finitely generated $R$-module of dimension $d$. Set $\mathfrak{a}(M):=\mathfrak{a}_0(M)\cdots \mathfrak{a}_{d-1}(M)$, where $\mathfrak{a}_i(M):={\rm Ann}_RH^i_{\mathfrak{m}}(M)$ for $i\geq 0$.
